note: Frontier log: dated releases, published results and shipped capabilities in AI, chips, robotics and autonomy. One entry per release; the run appends and never edits. kind = model|chip|robot|autonomy|result|tool.

releases.t: Tesla runs unsupervised robotaxi rides in Fort Worth
releases.n: Tesla's Robotaxi service began fully unsupervised public rides in Fort Worth, Texas, at 06:00 local time on 2 Nov, with no safety monitor on board, using Model Y cars across about 143 square miles. Fort Worth is the seventh unsupervised city after Austin, Dallas, Houston, Miami, Orlando and Tampa; fleet size and fares were not published.
src: Tesla expands Robotaxi service, launches unsupervised rides in Fort Worth

releases.t: Meituan releases LongCat-2.5: 1.6 trillion parameters, 48 billion active
releases.n: Meituan released LongCat-2.5 on 2 Nov, a multimodal mixture-of-experts model with 1.6 trillion total parameters and about 48 billion active per token, built for long agent runs over whole codebases. It is live in Meituan's chat service and API; open weights on GitHub and Hugging Face are promised but not yet out, and no benchmarks, context length or prices were published.
src: Meituan launches LongCat-2.5 multimodal AI model for extended coding tasks

releases.t: Agility's Digit passes 100,000 totes at a GXO warehouse
releases.n: Agility Robotics said on 2 Nov that its Digit humanoid has moved more than 100,000 totes at GXO's Georgia site since June 2024, a company figure; GXO signed for two more US sites, in Statesville, North Carolina and Lebanon, Tennessee, starting in early 2027. No unit counts were given.
src: Agility Robotics says more than 30 companies considering Digit humanoid robot

releases.t: SemiAnalysis launches GDPx; the best model scores 12%
releases.n: SemiAnalysis published GDPx on 2 Nov, a benchmark of long agentic tasks in 11 domains, scored pass@1 over three attempts with tasks of up to eight hours. Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic) leads at 12.0%, ahead of Gemini 4 Carbon (Google) at 10.9% and GPT-6 Astra (OpenAI) at 9.6%; finance and legal tasks score near zero.
src: SemiAnalysis unveils GDPx benchmark, and the best AI model scores 12%

releases.t: AMD ships MI450 and Helios; data-centre sales nearly double
releases.n: Q3 revenue $13.4 billion, data centre $8.5 billion (+97%); MI450 launched, Helios racks in use, ROCm 10 released.
src: AMD reports third quarter 2026 financial results

releases.t: Google DeepMind gives its Antigravity agent cheminformatics skills
releases.n: RDKit-based skills; the demo curated 568 compounds and benchmarked models across four readouts in about an hour.

releases.t: Baidu launches Apollo World driving simulator
releases.n: Up to 100,000 km of simulated driving a day; trains the Apollo Go robotaxi fleet.
src: China's Baidu launches AI model simulating road environment for robotaxis

releases.t: OpenAI pipeline finds 948 unique Linux kernel privilege-escalation exploits
releases.n: About 2.8 million lines scanned; 1,169 working exploits, 948 unique; $1,213,430 in API credits, about $1,279 each; 61 patched upstream.
src: OpenAI pipeline finds 948 Linux kernel privilege escalation flaws

releases.t: Cognition releases SWE-2 Flash coding model
releases.n: 276B parameters, 12B active; about 200 tokens a second; a fifth of SWE-2's price; FrontierCode 2.0 24.0; weights withheld.

releases.t: Tencent releases Hy4
releases.n: No parameter count or benchmarks published; weights to follow with a safety-testing report.
src: Tencent releases new AI model, pledges safeguards against cyberattack use

releases.t: OpenAI releases GPT-6 Cyber to vetted defenders
releases.n: Rated Critical for cybersecurity; ExploitGym 48.45% against GPT-6 Astra's 42.43%; working exploits for 948 of 1,724 reproduced Linux kernel flaws. [67, 68]

releases.t: Google ships Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash video model
releases.n: Clips up to 15 seconds, up to 4K after upscaling, $0.07 a second at 720p, 30% below Omni 1.1. [69]
src: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash: fast and cost-effective with longer clips

releases.t: Meta adds real-time voice and avatars to Muse
releases.n: US rollout on mobile, web and Mac; hundreds of voices; no latency figures published. [70]
src: Introducing Muse AI voice and expressive avatars

releases.t: Meta ships specialised Muse models with Active Memory
releases.n: Internal evals: Personal Superintelligence Index 47% (from 38%), Active Memory 90% (from 76%), 2.4x less forgetting. [69]
src: Bringing specialized models to Muse and Meta AI

releases.t: Thinking Machines releases Inkling 2 Small
releases.n: 594B total, 17B active; SWE-Bench Pro v2 (Hard) 86.3%; $0.30/$1.00 per M tokens; weights under Apache 2.0 promised. [71, 72]

releases.t: METR assesses AI R&D acceleration at Anthropic
releases.n: Internal progress about 1.9x faster than before Oct 2025 (95% interval 1.5–2.8); about 80% attributed to AI. [73]
src: AI R&D acceleration at Anthropic: an independent assessment

releases.t: Baidu opens ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base weights
releases.n: 280B total, 14B active; 33.5T tokens; MMLU-Pro 78.4. [129]

releases.t: Epoch estimates Huawei's Horinger campus at about 81,000 H100-equivalents
releases.n: 286 MW of AI IT power; about 14 times smaller than Colossus 2. [97]
src: What Huawei's Horinger data center reveals about China's compute gap

releases.t: Anthropic's Project EVE: Claude agents trade profitably in EVE Online replays
releases.n: Fable 5 averaged about 43% per two-week window; monitors caught 30–40% of saboteurs. [98]

releases.t: OpenAI's BioBasicsBench: GPT-6 Astra 66.7% on 100 wet-lab tasks
releases.n: 18,500 graded answers; GPT-5.5 scored 35.4%. [99]
src: OpenAI unveils BioBasicsBench, a benchmark to gauge how well AI agents read raw experimental data across 100 routine wet-lab tasks

releases.t: ByteDance Seed opens Cola2, an 8.8B continuous-latent diffusion language model
releases.n: Trained on 346 billion tokens; no licence posted. [100]

releases.t: DeepMind agents find two weaknesses in legacy 1024-bit RSA
releases.n: Signature forgery re-run with 3.5x less CPU time; a new method estimated at about 1,600x better for short digests; batch factoring about 30x cheaper per key; 2048-bit keys unaffected. [98, 99]
src: Advancing the frontier of cryptanalysis (Pushmeet Kohli, Google DeepMind), X article
Google DeepMind on legacy 1024-bit RSA, X post

releases.t: PSI's AI system proves the Aaronson–Ambainis conjecture, checked in Lean
releases.n: Proof complete on day 3 of the run using a non-public Anthropic model; self-published, under review by the Stanford group. [100]
src: A proof of the Aaronson-Ambainis conjecture

releases.t: Artificial Analysis publishes VIALS-AA, a scientific-image benchmark
releases.n: 161 tasks, pass^3: Gemini 4 Carbon 64%, GPT-6 Astra 63%, Claude Opus 5.5 61%. [101]
src: VIALS-AA: different paths to scientific image reasoning

releases.t: Artificial Analysis Decision Index v2
releases.n: Claude Haiku 5.5 77, GPT-6 Luna 76, Drex Max and GLiDE 73; Drex Max at $102 per million tasks. [102]
src: Introducing the Artificial Analysis Decision Index v2

releases.t: Anthropic releases Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2
releases.n: Fable 5.2: FrontierCode 2.0 49.1% (Opus 5.5 45.5%, GPT-6 Astra 42.8%), RoboDojo Sim 64.9%, Humanity’s Last Exam with tools 74.2%; Fermat’s Last Theorem formalised in Lean by 1,000 agents in 30 hours; Mythos 5.2 CVE Rediscovery 89.6% on 1,829 CVEs; $8/$40 per million tokens. [87]
src: Introducing Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2

releases.t: NVIDIA introduces GR00T 2 world action model and Isaac Lab 3.0 at CoRL
releases.n: 40% zero-shot on 50 unseen tasks, 95% with five demonstrations after a 30-minute fine-tune on one RTX 5090; pretrained on 402,730 h human video, 10,184 h handheld-gripper and 23,500 h robot data; Turbo 124 ms per prediction on Jetson Thor; Isaac Lab 3.0 up to 2.5x training throughput. [88, 89]
src: Practice Makes Precise: At CoRL, NVIDIA and Partners Reveal How Robots Rehearse Delicate Work in Simulation
GR00T 2: Scaling Robot Foundation Models for Generalization, Dexterity, and Adaptation

releases.t: Meta releases Muse Ember, an efficient-tier agent model
releases.n: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index 36 at $0.14 per task (Claude Haiku 5.5: 36 at $0.41); AutomationBench-AA 68.1%; hallucination rate 17.4% with 64% of knowledge questions declined; $0.10/$0.50 per million tokens. [91, 90]
src: Meta's Muse Ember is the cheapest model scoring 36 on the Intelligence Index
Meta releases Muse Ember, a new lightweight model for agent execution

releases.t: Google makes Gemini 4 Carbon generally available
releases.n: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5 59 (first); Coding Agent Index 59 against 62 for Claude Opus 5.5; $7.76 per index task against $10.04 for Opus 5.5; introductory price $2/$10 per million tokens; /swarm multi-agent preview in Antigravity. [89, 90, 91]
src: Gemini 4 Carbon is now available (Koray Kavukcuoglu, 10 Nov 2026)
Gemini 4 Carbon is the new #1 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5
Google releases Gemini 4 Carbon with agent ‘swarm’ feature (Robert Hart)

releases.t: Google DeepMind and Artificial Analysis launch the Multimodal Knowledge Agent benchmark
releases.n: 200 private visual tasks in 10 industries, about 70 rubric criteria each; Claude Fable 5.2 57%, Gemini 4 Carbon 54%, Claude Opus 5.5 53%; $31.97 against $6.29 per task (Fable 5.2 against Carbon). [92]
src: Multimodal Knowledge Agent (MKA) benchmark: testing knowledge work capabilities with complex visual files

releases.t: Google adds TPU 8tx for confidential inference and dual-chip TPU 8i Max
releases.n: Four eighth-generation TPU systems in one year; 8tx up to 2x lower latency than TPU 8t with hardware-level confidential compute; 8i Max doubles compute, SRAM and HBM bandwidth of TPU 8i; nearly 100 TPU customers. [93, 94]
src: Our newest TPUs: 8tx and 8i Max, built for the agentic era (9 Nov 2026)
Google broadens its AI hardware portfolio with two new specialized chips (Ram Iyer)

releases.t: AMD makes 6th Gen EPYC (Zen 6, ‘Venice’) server processors generally available
releases.n: 2P EPYC 9996 (2 x 256 cores, 600 W, $14,904 per chip) 5,470 SPECrate2017_int_base against 3,260 (EPYC 9965) and 2,510 (Xeon 6980P); up to 5.3 GHz; Helion racks up to 73,728 threads; TSMC N2P compute die. [217, 218]
src: AMD Showcases 6th Gen AMD EPYC Processors to Lead Next Era of AI and Enterprise Computing (press release, 10 Nov 2026)
AMD Zen 6 EPYC ‘Venice’ deep dive and benchmarking (Jake Roach)

releases.t: ExpertCrowd-SWE benchmark of 100 expert-written engineering tasks
releases.n: Claude Opus 5.5 67.3%, GPT-6 Astra 63.7%, Claude Fable 5.1 46.5%, Gemini 3.8 Flash 40.0%; 3,495 scored runs. [36]
src: ExpertCrowd-SWE: Measuring Frontier Coding Agents on Expert-Authored Engineering Tasks in Unfamiliar Codebases (arXiv:2611.13246)

releases.t: EarthRecord benchmark of agents on four decades of raw satellite imagery
releases.n: 56 sites, 238 questions, 12 agents; half of right answers follow an altered satellite feed. [37]
src: EarthRecord: From Pixels to Land Change with Multimodal Agents over Four Decades of Satellite Imagery (arXiv:2611.12934)

releases.t: AFRICOM contract to test Merlin Pilot autonomy on a Cessna 208B air ambulance
releases.n: $500,000 AFRICOM contract; $8.9 million SOCOM C-130J task order the day before. [38]
src: Autonomous Cessna Caravan air ambulance to be tested by U.S. military

releases.t: Gemini 4 Hydrogen becomes the model behind Google Search's AI Mode
releases.n: Called “the biggest model upgrade to Search yet”; no benchmark figures published. [59]
src: Google's new Gemini model is better at understanding complicated questions

releases.t: Study finds Gemini, Perplexity and ChatGPT showed risky shopping URLs in up to 15% of conversations
releases.n: Up to 15% of conversations displayed risky URLs. [60]
src: AI chatbots are recommending fake retail websites, study finds
